panels.title: Big questions
points: The Moon is falling towards the Earth all the time, yet never gets closer. How?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; each in an orbit is swimming' (Al-Anbiya 21:33). The precise orbits we calculate are part of the order Allah has set in the heavens.
